decision.reasoning_trace: Out of the 25 items, many were accessories (pots, sleeping pads, lights) rather than primary backpacks. Within the actual backpack options, I narrowed the consideration set to a mix of large hiking/tactical bags, a hydration pack, a branded mesh bag, and a small sling. The QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) was the clear winner due to its exceptionally high rating of 4.7 stars across over 6,000 reviews, suggesting a level of durability and utility that justifies its price point. It outperformed the SHENHU 40L (prod_backpacks_111) in perceived quality despite being slightly more expensive.
